description:
**Brand Introduction:**

Raw Brush, a brand born out of a deep love for vintage French art and a desire to bring a touch of European elegance into homes in the U.S. Every piece in our collection tells a story, transporting you to the charming streets of Paris or the serene French countryside. We believe that art should do more than decorate your walls—it should make you feel peaceful, evoke positive emotions, and bring joy into your daily life. At Raw Brush, we curate vintage original paintings that resonate with these values, offering our customers not just art, but a unique piece of history.

---

**Product Description:**

Raw Brush specializes in offering a curated selection of vintage original paintings, all handpicked from the heart of France. Each painting in our collection is chosen for its ability to tell a story, evoke a sense of peace, and bring positive energy into any space. Our artworks feature a range of subjects, from tranquil landscapes to intimate still lifes, all in colors that are meant to soothe and inspire. We take pride in offering authentic, one-of-a-kind pieces that add character, elegance, and a touch of history to your home.

---

**Unique Selling Point (USP):**

- **Authenticity:** Raw Brush exclusively offers original paintings—no prints, no reproductions—ensuring that each piece is unique and carries its own story.
- **French Heritage:** Our collection is sourced directly from France, offering a genuine connection to European art and culture.
- **Curated for Positivity:** Believing that art should bring peace, we carefully select paintings with subjects and colors that foster a positive atmosphere in your home.
- **Customer Experience:** We are committed to delivering a seamless and delightful shopping experience, from fast international shipping to exceptional customer support.

---

**Payment Terms:**

- **Commission Structure:** Affiliates earn a competitive commission on every sale made through their referral links.
- **Payout Frequency:** Commissions are paid out monthly, with a minimum payout threshold of $50.
- **Payment Methods:** Payments can be received via PayPal.
- **Tracking:** A reliable affiliate tracking system ensures accurate recording and payment of all referrals and commissions.

---

**Other Information:**

- **Marketing Support:** Affiliates will have access to a range of marketing materials to help them effectively promote Raw Brush.
- **Exclusive Offers:** Affiliates will be given access to exclusive discounts and promotions to share with your audience.
- **Affiliate Portal:** A dedicated portal allows affiliates to track performance, view earnings, and access marketing resources.

---

By joining our affiliate program, you become part of the Raw Brush story, helping to share the beauty and tranquility of French art. We look forward to partnering with you and creating a successful collaboration!

---
